R1_salary_and_expense_input.notes: Salary parsed from salary_bdt field; expenses parsed from expenses[] array with date, category, shop, amount. Image OCR is handled at input level via the JSON test format.

R2_monthly_dashboard.notes: Total spent vs salary, category breakdown with % bars, top-5 expenses for both current and last month.

R3_forecast_and_insights.notes: Daily burn rate projected to month end. Six named insights referencing specific categories and BDT amounts. Pro-rated comparison against last month.

R4_savings_pockets_and_dps.notes: Per-pocket: target, monthly contribution, months needed (ceiling division), estimated completion month. DPS simulation using the specified rule (deposit then interest each month).

team_members.contribution: Core data model, expense aggregation, category breakdown
Forecast engine, pro-rated comparison, insights generation
Savings pockets, DPS compound-interest simulation, output formatting

known_limitations: Live image OCR not implemented — JSON input supplies pre-parsed fields
No interactive CLI prompt — reads from JSON file only
Spending projection assumes constant daily rate for remainder of month
